normalizations: Join printed line wraps; preserve wording, case, numbers and printed grammar.
Full-width punctuation in the spec tables normalized to ASCII without changing values: '，' -> ', ' and '（…）' -> ' (…)'; 'W/㎡' -> 'W/m²'; '℃' -> '°C'.
Printed '*' bullet markers, '1.'-'4.' numbering and the FCC '--' measure markers become shared list markers (not doubled).
The printed callout label 'Note:' is carried by the shared HB-CALLOUT-STRIP label 'Note' (the shared component draws the label; colon dropped as in JS-40A US/en).
Omit decorative cover image and wordmark, contents page, US language tab, page numbers, package-list circled numbers and the three Customer Service marker icons; all substantive copy remains native.
The medium-weight sentence 'We recommend standing the solar panel vertically before hinge installation.' is rendered bold to keep its printed emphasis.
The package-list hinge reuses the identical p.7 hinge drawing (one crop for both slots).
Package-list quantities ('x 6', 'x 10', 'x 8', 'x 40', 'x 2') are joined to their item name with non-breaking spaces so a quantity never wraps onto its own line; characters are otherwise unchanged.

shared_component_exceptions.reason: HB-TABLE-SPEC is a two-column label/value component; this printed table has a third column (an in-table 'Electrical Data | STC | BNPI' header row with two value columns, and single values spanning both columns). It is kept as one native shared-wrapper table with the printed row order, column spans and header row instead of splitting or re-shaping the source table.
